scope: Disposable local Realms with minimal fixtures and Headless Clients; five Cargo jobs; no recording

publish_comparison.driver: Python HTTP driver for direct PUT; pinned spacetime 2.7.1 for stock publish

edits.change: Fix a compile error with a second prefix

configuration_only.driver: Operator reducer call; no WASM build or publish

limits: Build and publish comparison phases were timed separately; their sum is not a measured watcher round.
Two warm edits per build or publication mode are not a capacity or statistical performance study.
The complete watcher uses larger Speech-prefix edits than the isolated arithmetic comparison.
The final Host rebuild changed only cache tests from the benchmark Host.
This does not update the earlier Benilla footage or establish equivalent timings while recording.
Cold builds, full imported content, macOS and production load were not measured.
The function cache is experimental in Wasmtime 39 and is enabled only for Development reload.
Long edit runs that fill the FIFO cache were not timed; eviction can recompile frequently used functions.
The real watcher run precedes the final HTTP error-message repair; the final CLI has focused HTTP tests.
